answers.assumption_check: Measured: on akiendelllinux /tmp is a 7.7G tmpfs; isolation.py:459 and :498 make the pristine snapshot and the seal swap with tempfile.mkdtemp, which honours TMPDIR and otherwise lands on /tmp; each seal copies ~1.4G (cairn-instance-pristine-* 685M + cairn-instance-seal-* 685M). At 08:2x a seal from akienasus's 0da9 prove (pid 2071739, swap under /tmp) and a sealed --exec of mine with no TMPDIR ran together and the second died 'No space left on device' in snapshot_instance_space. The processes that start seals without a caller's export carry no TMPDIR: the live bus (pid 2083024, cairn.devices.cairn.machines.bus serve), the ground loop (pid 9567) and every superclaude session (/proc/<pid>/environ), because remote.py:323 and shim.py:191 launch units through systemd-run carrying only CAIRN_*, HOME and PATH. With TMPDIR=/var/tmp (ext4, 765G free) a 21-proof reseal plus a 2-proof seal left /tmp flat at 2.1G free over 13 samples 30 s apart (/home/akien/.cairn/devices/cc/0/scratch/akiendelllinux_cc_0/tmpwatch/samples.txt). Assumed: /var/tmp is disk-backed on every Linux box we run; the chooser checks it rather than trusting it. Windows: tempfile already lands on %TEMP% (disk); the chooser leaves Windows as it is.
answers.builder_check: isolation.py chooses its swap root once: the caller's TMPDIR when set, else a disk-backed dir it owns (e.g. /var/tmp, checked not tmpfs, else ~/.cairn/devices/tester/0/temp/), and passes dir= to both mkdtemp calls and to line 374's root. The proof drives the chooser over a scratch mountinfo/temp layout for clauses 1 and 3, and runs two seals at once under a scratch small tmpfs default for clause 2 (or a sized fake that refuses a write past its cap, if a tmpfs mount is not available unprivileged). Swap dirs keep their prefixes (_PRISTINE_PREFIX, _SEAL_PREFIX) so the sweeps that find them still do.
answers.children: none, because the systemd-run env (remote.py, shim.py) is not changed here: the seal chooses its own disk, so no launcher has to remember TMPDIR
answers.collision_check: no open ticket names isolation.py's mkdtemp (grep CairnCommons/tickets for isolation.py + mkdtemp, 2026-11-20); the scratch-sweep sieves read the prefixes, which stay
answers.falsifier_check: 3 clauses: (1) with TMPDIR unset, an instance seal's pristine snapshot and swap are made on a directory that is not a tmpfs (read from /proc/self/mountinfo for the swap's path); (2) with TMPDIR unset and a tmpfs mounted at the default temp dir with less free space than one snapshot, two concurrent instance seals both complete; (3) with TMPDIR set by the caller, the swap is made under it, as today
answers.gates_bound: code-seam: BUILDME entry gate, PROVEME build gate, PROVED exit gate
